messages:
kim: heads-up — deploy-bot paused the promo for commit abc123. one matrix axis failing: linux-arm64-integration. noticed during the final gated canary.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion paused for commit abc123 due to 1 failing job: linux-arm64-integration. See CI: https://ci.internal/runs/2002 :warning:

sanjay: grabbing logs now, can someone paste the job link (or I can open the above)

marta: job link ^ — logs show repeated artifact fetch timeouts from registry mirror

sanjay: log snippet:
```
2026-03-21T15:34:02Z ERROR fetch_layer registry.internal/artifacts/abcd: GET /v2/.../blobs/sha256:... 504 Gateway Time-out
2026-03-21T15:34:12Z WARN retrying with fallback mirror -> 403 Forbidden
```

kim: we had a short maintenance window on the registry earlier; maybe the multipart mirror didn't finish committing. this is different from checksum flips we've seen.

jordan: can we re-run just the failing axis? we should avoid full re-run if other axes are green.

lucy: deploy-bot supports per-axis rerun: `deploy-bot rerun --commit=abc123 --axis=linux-arm64-integration`

sanjay: ok queued the rerun (thanks). fingers crossed it's transient.

marta: FYI release window ends 17:00 PT — if this hangs we'll need to decide quick whether to manual-promote previous commit.

kim: what does manual-promote look like? we'd need to pin the promoted tag to last-green (def456) and publish notes.

jordan: manual promote command: `deploy-bot promote --tag=release-2026-03-21 --commit=def456 --reason="last good"` but that skips the new changes.

sanjay: current rerun is running... if it succeeds we can continue with abc123. if it fails again, propose we pin to def456 and open a short postmortem.

lucy: re-run finished — logs: same 504 during blob fetch, then fallback 403. failing early before test run.

kim: looks like the artifact didn't replicate to the arm mirror. can infra check registry replication health? @marta can you escalate to infra?

marta: escalating to infra now; pinged #eng-infra with headers and the failing blob id. also asked for mirror resync.

deploy-bot: [automated] Re-run failed for linux-arm64-integration (abc123). Promotion remains paused.

jordan: given time constraints I'm leaning to pin to def456. we can release a hotfix branch for abc123 once infra confirms artifact integrity.

kim: agree — we can't keep customers waiting beyond window. kim: motion to pin to def456 and publish release notes indicating a follow-up hotfix. :+1: from me.

sanjay: +1 (we should include brief note: `artifact push failed to arm mirror; rebuilding/repush in progress`).

lucy: +1

marta: +1 — infra expects mirror resync within ~30m but we don't want to gamble on the release window.

kim: action items:
- @marta escalate and follow infra resync (will post updates in #eng-infra)
- @jordan run `deploy-bot promote --tag=release-2026-03-21 --commit=def456 --reason="pin after artifact mirror failure"` once you have approval from release mgr
- @sanjay capture logs and create a short incident ticket linking the blob id and CI job
- @lucy prepare release notes with a short follow-up line about a subsequent hotfix if needed

jordan: running manual promote now. deploy-bot will post status when the promote job completes.

deploy-bot: [automated] Manual promote initiated by jordan for tag release-2026-03-21 -> commit def456. Promotion job 3011 queued.

marta: infra update in #eng-infra: mirror resync started, but it's best-effort. will confirm whether abc123 artifacts are intact.

kim: thanks everyone. we'll call this pinned for the public release. when infra confirms mirror resync, we can re-run the full canary for abc123 and decide whether to ship a quick hotfix.

sanjay: created incident INC-20260321-01 with logs and CI link.

lucy: release notes draft saved in drive: docs/releases/2026-03-21-draft.md — will include one-liner about artifact mirror regen + follow-up

kim: closing thread — release will go out with def456. please keep updates in #eng-infra and post final status here if anything changes. :shipit:
